What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine ===

[Source 1 — www.bbc.co.uk (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c65y19wy3xl8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss):
What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine

Russia struck bridges and railway stations in the capital Kyiv in a major attack.

[Source 2 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261120-russia-pummels-ukraine-with-massive-strikes-missile-hits-poland):
Russia pummels Ukraine with massive strikes, missile hits Poland

Moscow pounded Ukraine with massive strikes Friday, with Kyiv saying at least six people were killed in the capital, and neighbouring Poland reporting two Russian missiles likely landed in the south-east corner of the NATO country, accusing Moscow of a "provocation." Hours earlier, Russia's Vladimir Putin vowed a "painful" response to Kyiv's strikes on Moscow's Crimea bridge after holding a summit with China's Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.
